_note: v2 hook overrides for la montagne (B26_montagne). Source hooks are kept wherever the painting can show them; these replace only hooks whose setting does not fit the ski slopes or that differ from what is painted (several source hooks used a goat; one goat is kept for la montagne, the others became different animals or people so each picture is distinct).

fr_cote_noun_2.why: Source hook is set on the sea coast; this room is the mountain, so the painting uses the 'slope' sense with the same coat.

fr_rocher_noun.why: Owner's review 2026-10-25: le rocher is a person rowing a boat through the snow (row-Shay); replaces the seal.

fr_descente_noun.why: Owner's review 2026-10-25: the apple pie now sits right on the skier's way down (the old pie by the tent was removed).

fr_saut_noun.why: Source has the frog jumping over a puddle; on the slopes it flies off a ski jump.

fr_monture_noun.why: Painting shows the knight already in the saddle rather than climbing on.

fr_ascension_noun.why: Source uses a goat (the goat is la montagne); the little bear that replaced it broke Lesson 2, so a boy climbs now (repainted).

fr_cime_noun.why: Painting shows the zipper on the peak without the goat (the goat is la montagne).

fr_val_noun.why: Source makes Val a goat; Val is painted as a girl to keep the goats distinct.

fr_foulee_noun.why: The king is not painted; the jester's stride is.

fr_sierra_noun.why: Painting shows the saw beside the peaks; no goat (the goat is la montagne).

fr_alpiniste_noun.why: Source makes the mountaineer a goat; the painting shows a woman mountaineer.

fr_talus_noun.why: Owner's review 2026-10-25 had approved a tall loo on a sled; Oct 31 2026 the owner asked for American hooks, so the loo was repainted as a very tall man on a little luge: TALL LUGE ≈ tah-LEW.

fr_grotte_noun.why: Source has a polar bear sweeping. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook, so a person does the action now (repainted).

fr_sommet_noun.why: Source has a llama in a woolly hat. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook, so a person does the action now (repainted).

fr_ski_noun.why: Source has a penguin skiing. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook, so a person does the action now (repainted).

fr_rampe_noun.why: Source has a snowboarding penguin. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook, so a person does the action now (repainted).

fr_escalade_noun.why: Source has a goat climbing with a rope. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook, so a person does the action now (repainted).

fr_caverne_noun.why: Source bear wore a woolly hat; Lesson 2: it is now a plain sleeping bear (repainted).

fr_traction_noun.why: Source has a muscly marmot. Lesson 2: no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal IS the hook, so a person does the action now (repainted).

fr_chamois_noun.why: 'shah-MWAH' = kiss sound; real chamois on a ledge above the ice

fr_echo_noun.why: Paint-back: plan-only since p20 (from plage/plage); painted into montagne/montagne (R_mountain_01, its planned room).

fr_hauteur_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (o-TUR -> oh-TUHR).

fr_neiger_verb.why: La neige = snow → neiger = to snow. Impersonal: only il neige, il neigeait, il a neigé… Regular -er (il neigeait): RED beret. Wave 1 oct29: moved from st_riviere/st_riviere into montagne/montagne; hook rewritten to match the new painting.

fr_figer_verb.why: Figer = to freeze still, to set, to congeal (oil, a smile). Regular -er (nous figeons): RED beret. Wave 1 oct29: moved from st_riviere/glacons into montagne/montagne; hook rewritten to match the new painting.
ex: Le froid le fige sur place.
The cold freezes him to the spot.

fr_glacer_verb.why: La glace = ice → glacer = to freeze, to chill. Regular -er (nous glaçons): RED beret. Wave 1 oct29: moved from st_riviere/glacons into montagne/etang; hook rewritten to match the new painting.
